MRVL.pe_narrative: MRVL's multiple collapsed in 2025 (shares down near 50% YTD at the low) on fears it lost Amazon Trainium share and a broader AI-capex-slowdown rotation, despite 88% YoY data-center growth. It re-rated sharply higher through 2026 as the Google $12.2B warrant deal and Investor Day's $70-90B FY31 target validated the custom-silicon thesis, pushing NTM EV/EBITDA to ~44x versus Broadcom's ~25x and Nvidia's ~17x - now drawing fresh 'priced for perfection' downgrades.
